source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Usability and Security Tradeoffs' (PDF 21): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Usability ka matlab hai system ko use karna kitna aasan hai. Usable (aasani se chalne wala) system simple (saada) aur clear (wazeh) hota hai. Users use jaldi seekh lete hain. Kaam baghair confusion (uljhan) ke ho jate hain. Achhi usability waqt aur mehnat bachati hai. Is se user satisfaction (user ki tasalli) barhti hai.

Security ka matlab hai systems aur data ko protect karna (bachana). Yeh unauthorized access (baghair ijazat pohanch) rokti hai. Security viruses aur hackers se bachati hai. Yeh maloomat ko private (raaz mein) aur mehfooz rakhti hai. Strong (mazboot) security risks (khatre) aur damage (nuqsan) kam karti hai. Har system ko basic (bunyadi) security chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Usability aur security ki ek ek line mein tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Usability: system kitni aasani se chalaya ja sakta hai. Security: system aur data ko baghair ijazat pohanch, viruses aur hackers se bachana.

items: Usability: aasan, saada, jaldi seekhna. Security: baghair ijazat pohanch, viruses aur hackers se hifazat.
